meta.name: Better This World
meta.description: How did two childhood friends from Midland, Texas end up arrested on terrorism charges at the 2008 Republican National Convention?Better This Worldfollows the journey of David McKay and Bradley Crowder from activist beginners to accused domestic terrorists with a particular focus on the relationship they develop with an FBI informant named Brandon Darby in six months leading up to their arrests. Weaving through a story of entrapment, idealism, political struggle and ultimate betrayal,Better This Worldwinds up at questions of the core machinery of the justice system and its impact on civil liberties and political dissent in the modern “post-9/11 world.”
